---
description: "Use when editing Blazor and C# files in this repo to enforce project coding conventions."
applyTo: "**/*.razor,**/*.cs"
---

# Blazor and C# Conventions

- Write idiomatic and efficient Blazor and C# code.
- Follow .NET and Blazor conventions.
- Use Razor Components appropriately for component-based UI development.
- Prefer inline functions for smaller components, but move complex logic into code-behind files or service classes.
- Use async/await where applicable to keep UI operations non-blocking.
- Add short, high-value comments around non-obvious changes to explain what changed and why.
